summary: Tested Kitchen Unpack Bug Fix: items transferred from Bag to Table slots now appear VISIBLE with non-zero dimensions. Verified fix in renderTableItemInSlot() - Animated.View now has explicit width:'100%' height:'100%'. All 7 acceptance criteria passed.
critical_code_review_comments: kitchen.tsx line 1552: Animated.View in renderTableItemInSlot now has style=[{width:'100%', height:'100%', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'}, isNew ? unpackAnimStyle : {}] - fix is correctly applied.

The fix resolves the Yoga/Flexbox zero-size collapse: parent Pressable (soupSlotTouch) provides the container, but Animated.View was previously unsized → Image with width/height 100% collapsed to 0x0. Now Animated.View explicitly fills the parent, so Image renders at full slot size.
Item quantity badges (e.g. '3', '5') render correctly over the item image via tableItemQty style.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: In renderTableItemInSlot(), the Animated.View had no explicit size. The parent Pressable with style=soupSlotTouch has a defined size, but Animated.View without dimensions defaults to 0x0 in Yoga layout (React Native's Flexbox engine). The child Image with style=soupInSlotImg (likely width:'100%' height:'100%') therefore computed to 0x0. Fix: Adding width:'100%' height:'100%' to Animated.View makes Yoga assign it the full parent slot dimensions, which propagates to the Image.
